definitions.explanation: A carved stamp used in Japan instead of a handwritten signature for official documents, contracts, and everyday transactions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{判子|はんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}して→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please stamp your seal on the contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{判子|はんこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: You need a seal to open a new bank account.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宅配便|たくはいびん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧⟦とき→〜時：03094_toki⟧、{判子|はんこ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦サイン→サイン：03846_sain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{要|い}る→要る：noentry⟧。
examples.english: When receiving a delivery, you need either a seal or a signature.

notes:
{判子|はんこ} is an essential item in Japanese daily life, used for signing documents, receiving packages, and official paperwork.

Types of seals:
- ⟦{認印|みとめいん}→認印：07489_mitomein⟧ (personal seal for everyday use)
- ⟦{実印|じついん}→実印：07490_jitsuin⟧ (registered seal for important documents)
- {銀行印|ぎんこういん} (bank seal)
- シャチハタ (self-inking stamp, brand name often used generically)

Common expressions:
- {判子|はんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (to stamp a seal)
- {判子|はんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to have a seal made)

Related terms:
- ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧ (seal - more formal term)
- ⟦{押印|おういん}→押印：07488_ouin⟧ (stamping a seal - formal)

Cultural note:
While signatures are becoming more common, seals remain important in Japan for ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧ accounts, contracts, and official documents.
